Create one exquisite, highly legible, full-width 16:9 DESKTOP OCCULT SIMULATION GAME screenshot concept, preferably 2560x1440. Simplified Chinese. This is an eldritch-god management simulation, not an RPG hero screen and not enterprise software. The player has persistent cults, followers and relics in disconnected realities. The game must breathe visually and express the occult world; only a few important states are shown by default, deeper numbers are revealed locally. Strong illustration and material character, readable Chinese text, no garish neon.

CRITICAL DESIGN CHANGE: THERE ARE MORE CULTS AND RELICS THAN THE SCREEN CAN DISPLAY. This is normal. NEVER enumerate every cult as a physical diorama, every relic as a thumbnail, or every object's full statistics. The picture MUST show aggregate counts, name lookup/navigation, a CLEAR visible range indicator plus scrollbar or pagination, and a persistent direct link to offscreen crises. The rich playfield shows only the current selection and a few relevant objects. Do NOT imply four objects is a gameplay slot limit. Scrolling/viewing must not imply changing focus, ownership, geography or travel. Unknown worlds are not actual stars on one shared geographic map.

Shared illustrative game situation for all three concepts:
"第46回合 · 自由行动"; resources "低语 4/5", "信仰 18/125", "苏醒 65".
Small but readable "教团12", "圣物18", "世界档案12", "人物", "关注世界3/3". Cult total means 12 existing cults. Relics are 18 individual items, not 18 types; six types can repeat. Never draw 18 items.
"祈求 已回应1/1 · 另2项只读" is a small collapsed status, NOT a large actionable prayer card.
Selected cult is "镜证议会·04的教团", leader "记录者 N04", small "信众64 · 凝聚70", current order "传教" and current income "+5". Three orders clearly accessible "传教 / 敛藏 / 守持"; selected "传教". Local actual consequence "传教 −2信仰 · +2信众 · 察觉+2". A small alternative reads "守持：省2，供奉足额". A related root-shaped iron nail named "根钉 R03" supports its anchor. Compact relation reads "N04护持 · 根钉R03绑定 · 苏醒贡献+4". This is one person with multiple roles, NOT an extra keeper. No giant person portrait.
Only when current detail requires it, show small "秘密集会 2低语·4信仰" as additional action distinct from powers.
Current anchor is STILL ACTIVE. The budget shortage is prospective. Common concise warning: "供奉缺1 · 结算时苏醒65→61". A compact expanded budget in the current decision reads "现有18 → 传教6 → 余12 / 供奉需13". Secondary income if shown: "预计收入+42，结算后到账". No huge financial table.
Offscreen crisis direct link "焚星圣统·10：本轮末扣押空名印R11 ›". Another minor notice "千面公社·06：祈求余1轮". Both persist even if their cult objects are not in view.
Small latest chronicle always exposed, "编年史 ›" / "46轮 已回应祈求，低语5→4"; end turn control "结束回合".
Accessible current-world detail entry "世界资料 ›"; safe short contextual descriptor if needed "镜证议会 · 星球文明". Do NOT expose an omniscient table of world numbers.

Name navigation content, for a visible scroll window of six names:
"教团 12" with an actual magnifier / "查找名称", small "1–6 / 12", and a scroll bar whose thumb is half the track.
"镜证议会·01"
"盐梦诸邦·02"
"千面公社·03"
"镜证议会·04" selected
"盐梦诸邦·05"
"千面公社·06" small due-warning.
No numerical statistics columns next to these names. This is a compact navigational index, not the main gameplay surface. Future 30+ records use the same lookup/scroll, NOT smaller icons. If the concept instead specifies horizontal 5-name range, obey that variant's replacement.

Relic browser must show only FOUR illustrative objects and the explicit total "圣物18", "1–4 / 18", a clear scrollbar/pagination, plus "查找" and "展开". These four entries can be:
"根钉 R03 · 世界04绑定" (selected)
"余响铃 R08 · N01携带"
"空名印 R11 · N10携带" (risk)
"见证透镜 R14 · 世界03保管".
Exactly four visible relics in the browser, not all18. These are different states and real local ownership, NOT an infinitely portable bag. A tiny summary may read "绑定7 · 携带5 · 保管6". Give the pieces evocative distinct silhouettes. Avoid spending a third of the picture on an item grid.

All TWELVE powers are accessible in the SAME fixed order. Prefer all twelve named glyphs visibly on one modest rail, each recognizable but not taking over the screen:
聆听, 入梦, 谕言, 赐予, 任命, 献祭, 穿隙, 播种, 锚定, 掩迹, 迁引, 降临.
Only 降临 is dim, with tiny "需苏醒90". Do NOT add arbitrary locks to others. Costs need not all appear at once; a selected/hovered power can show cost. No "five favorite powers + more", no shuffled ordering.

Typography is planar and crisp even on illustrated surfaces, important labels readable at normal desktop scale. Keep large calm visual shapes and meaningful negative space. No giant title or explanatory design labels inside the screenshot, no lorem ipsum, no instruction essay. A game, not a slide, not a multi-panel comparison image. No web navigation tabs, KPI cards, table rows, or decorative framing around every line.
VARIANT A — ECHO SEA: a spacious continuous, pannable PERCEPTION PLAYFIELD. The camera looks down into a luminous ink-black ocean of impressions, atmospheric hand-painted fragments of impossible realities, silver-green ink, charcoal and muted bone. The image should resemble a beautiful living occult strategy table without being a literal human table. No gilded RPG medieval frame, no 12-shrine array. An expanse of shadow and reflected light is essential.

Layout:
A very narrow world/cult name index runs along the far LEFT, about 14% width, like suspended strips of vellum, not a boxed software sidebar. Exactly the six cult names and scroll indicator from shared context appear. The main canvas dominates ~70% width with just THREE distinct cult-related presences: selected mirror-archive cult04 in the central foreground, a smaller maritime salt-dream cult02 above-left ("盐梦诸邦·02 · 传教"), and a distant multiple-mask cult06 on the right ("千面公社·06 · 祈求余1轮"). These do not share terrain or a navigable universe; they are disconnected impressions separated by waterlike void. They are drawn substantially, sculptural/painterly and rich in mood, not small card thumbnails. We are not illustrating a map or distances. One light thread for SELECTED object relation only.
The selected mirror-archive presence contains tiny collective mortal figures, mirrored manuscripts, its cult emblem. Its nearby detached leader seal N04 and root nail R03 become usable pieces, connected only to this selected cult. A small readable floating action fan gives the three cult orders and the local costs. The rest of the scene is not covered in numbers. The current person's image is tiny compared to the cult and its environment.
A small view control at lower left of the canvas shows "缩放 −  +", "返回所选", and "定位" on the name index. This visibly communicates the scene is a VIEWPORT, not all objects in the game. NO small dots enumerating all cults.
On the right edge a concise crisis marker points out of the canvas: "世界10 · 本轮末扣押 R11 ›", still readable without rendering that world.
The relic browser is a half-open shallow supernatural cabinet in the LOWER RIGHT, occupying at most 20% width and 25% height: only four small objects, "圣物18", visible "1–4 / 18", scrollbar or next arrow, "查找 · 展开". It overlaps the canvas edge naturally, not a full-height 18-item inventory.
A modest horizontal twelve-power glyph rail along the bottom. Small chronicle and end turn below it. Resource HUD thin at top. Budget warning sits near current action, readable but secondary to the image.
Distinct composition priority: free spatial juxtaposition, substantial breathing room, only locally relevant relations expanded, indexed access to the unseen remainder.
